item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/blog/losing-money-on-cable-assembly-quotes","version_id":"33abdbe4f75624efed189d40297ade0c2f12f250f578435d87954b3c34d4693e","decision":"accept","reason":"This timely commercial source is directly relevant to manufacturing design: it describes using drawing-derived BOMs and connector/wire compatibility checks to surface missing build details before a wire-harness quote is committed. Cableteque claims its system fills 60–80% of an existing labor template and cites Resco Electronics reducing standard quotes from five-plus days to two to three; these are attributable vendor/customer claims, not independent proof, because the article does not disclose task sets, error rates, attempt counts, or an external audit. It provides quotable passages and a useful buyer-facing core-test question: whether flagged omissions, price comparisons, and labor estimates are checked against released production outcomes rather than merely generated from drawings.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
